items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: The interviewee states 'My name is William Risley. During my music career, I was better known as Bebe Risley.'

ctx.x: My name is William Risley. During my music career, I was better known as Bebe Risley. I lived in 907 Edinburgh Street. I first played bass violin, then I played trombone, and I played drum. And so I lost my health.

Let me put my name on here. I'm Dick Allen. Okay. He wanted to ask you some questions about trombone playing. He just was asking you one, so I thought we'd better get the machine on before you explain too much. Ask him the question again.
